instruction: Blender application icon on the desktop

events.raw:
Blender isn't visible as a labeled icon. The desktop holds only Google Ads Editor, TextEdit, brewd-coffee and checkin, and no Dock icon shows the Blender logo. Since the target must be present, it is most likely one of the two generic question-mark icons in the Dock. macOS shows a question mark when an app's original file can't be found.

1. The <element>first question-mark icon ("?")</element> in the <area>right section of the Dock, after the separator</area>. It sits next to the <neighbor>Claude app icon (orange starburst)</neighbor> and the <neighbor>second question-mark icon</neighbor>.

2. The <element>second question-mark icon ("?")</element> in the <area>right section of the Dock</area>. It sits between the <neighbor>first question-mark icon</neighbor> and the <neighbor>minimized window thumbnail with a Finder badge</neighbor>, near the <neighbor>Trash</neighbor>.

3. The <area>desktop icon column on the right side of the screen</area>, near the <neighbor>Google Ads Editor icon</neighbor>, <neighbor>TextEdit alias</neighbor>, <neighbor>brewd-coffee folder</neighbor> and <neighbor>checkin folder</neighbor>. However, no Blender icon is actually visible there.
